blocks.text: The Senate resumes the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday, October 5, as senators continue deliberations in the historic trial. Follow CDN Digital’s live coverage below for the latest developments, key exchanges, and updates from the Senate as the proceedings unfold. Bribery charge vs Sara Duterte to be dropped by prosecution MANILA, Philippines — The bribery charge against Vice President Sara Duterte will be dropped by the House prosecutors. This will end weeks of deliberations as the House prosecutors seek to shorten VP Duterte’s impeachment trial and focus on evidence they believe is sufficient to secure her conviction […]...
